English | 中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"Co-Engram is a self-evolving memory system for AI agents and teams. Unlike traditional vector stores"},{"id":"p4s2","text":" that only retrieve, Co-Engram models memory after the brain: engrams strengthen with use, weaken wh"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"en they fail, consolidate during sleep, and verify themselves through metacognition."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"Works with **Claude Code** (via MCP), **OpenClaw** (via plugin SDK), and **DeepSeek Harness** (via n"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"ative Cordis plugin), with a host-agnostic TypeScript core you can embed anywhere."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Why Co-Engram"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"| Differentiator                      | What it means                                               "},{"id":"p7s2","text":"                                                                                                    "},{"id":"p7s3","text":"                                                                                          |"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"| **Stable IDs + single-file layout** | Every memory is one Markdown file with YAML frontmatter. The"},{"id":"p8s2","text":" engram has a ULID that never changes, so renames, moves, and rewrites don't break references — whil"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"e content diffs stay clean in Git.                                                        |
| **Per-"},{"id":"p8s4","text":"edge synapses**               | Connections between memories live as independent files keyed by a de"},{"id":"p8s5","text":"terministic hash of `(from, to, kind)`. No duplicate edges, trivial dedupe, and pruning a stale edge"},{"id":"p8s6","text":" is a single file delete.                                                         |
| **Self-maintai"},{"id":"p8s7","text":"ning**                | A maintenance engine runs `light` (RPE-based reinforcement), `deep` (consoli"},{"id":"p8s8","text":"dation + decay), and `rem` (metacognition upgrade/refute) stages automatically — no manual tagging r"},{"id":"p8s9","text":"equired.                                                                  |
| **Two-layer proposal f"},{"id":"p8s10","text":"ilter**       | Implicit memory proposals pass through a rule-based prefilter (Layer 1, zero-cost) p"},{"id":"p8s11","text":"lus a necessity evaluator (Layer 2 — rule-based by default, optional LLM) — mechanical repetition ge"},{"id":"p8s12","text":"ts rejected, only genuinely reusable decisions become candidates. |
| **Host-agnostic core**        "},{"id":"p8s13","text":"      | `@co-engram/core` has zero host dependencies. Same memory, same tools, whether you use Claud"},{"id":"p8s14","text":"e Code, OpenClaw, DeepSeek Harness, or your own agent.                                              "},{"id":"p8s15","text":"                                                                            |"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## Quickstart"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"Three commands to get Co-Engram working inside Claude Code:"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"Restart Claude Code, run `/mcp` in a new session, and you should see the `co-engram` tools loaded."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"**Zero-install alternative** (skip step 1): replace `co-engram-mcp` in step 4 with `npx -y @co-engra"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"alternative** (skip step 1): replace `co-engram-mcp` in step 4 with `npx -y @co-engram/claude-code`."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"### OpenClaw"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"> The `--dangerously-force-unsafe-install` flag is required because `scripts/setup.mjs` uses `child_"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"process` to auto-configure the merge driver. This is safe for this plugin. Once install is complete,"},{"id":"p16s3","text":" the Co-Engram tools (memory_search, memory_get) are available to your agents."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"For detailed configuration, see docs/host-openclaw.md."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"### DeepSeek Harness"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"That's all — the package ships a `dsh.bundle` patch, so the plugin activates as a profile layer with"},{"id":"p20s2","text":" zero manual config. All 40 tools register under bare names (`engram_search`, …) and a `memory:co-en"},{"id":"p20s3","text":"gram` prompt section injects live signals (top tags / skills / path overview) at every prompt assemb"},{"id":"p20s4","text":"ly. Shares the same data repo as the Claude Code and OpenClaw hosts via a process lock."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"For detailed configuration, see docs/host-dsh.md."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"## Using Co-Engram"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"Co-Engram works **through conversation** — you talk to your AI agent, and it decides when to capture"},{"id":"p23s2","text":", search, or update memories. Every interaction below happens in natural language; the tool calls sh"},{"id":"p23s3","text":"own are what the agent executes transparently under the hood."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"### Install through conversation"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"For new projects you don't need to leave the chat. Ask the agent:"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"> "Globally install co-engram from npm and set up the memory store under my home directory.""},{"id":"p27s1","text":"Agent responds by running: `npm install -g @co-engram/claude-code` → `mkdir -p ~/team-memory && cd ~"},{"id":"p27s2","text":"/team-memory && git init` → `co-engram config data-root $HOME/team-memory` → `claude mcp add co-engr"},{"id":"p27s3","text":"am --scope user -- co-engram-mcp`. For OpenClaw: `openclaw plugins install @co-engram/openclaw --dan"},{"id":"p27s4","text":"gerously-force-unsafe-install` → `openclaw config set plugins.slots.memory co-engram` → `openclaw ga"},{"id":"p27s5","text":"teway restart`. For DeepSeek Harness: `dsh plugin --profile <name> add @co-engram/dsh`. Everything i"},{"id":"p27s6","text":"s done in one conversation — no manual steps. See Quickstart for the explicit commands."},{"id":"p28s1","text":"### The system learns what matters to you"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"You don't need to decide what's worth remembering. Co-Engram **watches your conversations** and noti"},{"id":"p29s2","text":"ces when a topic keeps coming up without a saved memory."},{"id":"p30s1","text":"> Over three sessions, you keep discussing the same CI pipeline timeout issue. You never explicitly "},{"id":"p30s2","text":"said "remember this."
>
> Co-Engram's proposal engine detects the repeated pattern and suggests a ca"},{"id":"p30s3","text":"ndidate engram. The agent tells you: "I noticed we've discussed the CI timeout issue several times. "},{"id":"p30s4","text":"Should I save it?"
>
> You say yes → `engram_accept_proposal` → it becomes a permanent engram with `"},{"id":"p30s5","text":"kind=pattern` and domain tags inferred from context."},{"id":"p31s1","text":"Behind this: a **two-layer filter** blocks noise. Layer 1 (zero-cost rules) rejects greetings, one-w"},{"id":"p31s2","text":"ord answers, and mechanical repetition. Layer 2 (configurable: rule-based by default, optional LLM) "},{"id":"p31s3","text":"checks "is this reusable knowledge, or just conversation filler?" Only proposals that pass both laye"},{"id":"p31s4","text":"is reusable knowledge, or just conversation filler?" Only proposals that pass both layers reach you."},{"id":"p32s1","text":"You can also browse pending candidates anytime: ask "any memory suggestions?" and the agent calls `e"},{"id":"p32s2","text":"ngram_list_proposals`. Approve with `engram_accept_proposal`, dismiss with `engram_dismiss_proposal`"},{"id":"p32s3","text":"gram_list_proposals`. Approve with `engram_accept_proposal`, dismiss with `engram_dismiss_proposal`."},{"id":"p33s1","text":"### Tiered disclosure: pay only for what you need"},{"id":"p34s1","text":"The LLM's context window is finite and expensive. Co-Engram's progressive disclosure runs along **tw"},{"id":"p34s2","text":"o orthogonal axes** — survey the repo structure first (breadth), then read a single memory (depth). "},{"id":"p34s3","text":"Each layer returns only the minimum information the current question needs."},{"id":"p35s1","text":"## Architecture"},{"id":"p36s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"}],"truncated":true}
